description:
Read G1–G8 geospatial data contracts, native node availability, WGS84/CRS
        requirements, raster modes, G7 indexing and G8 Nx7 OGR vector topology.
        Specify workflow='coastal_raster', 'tiled_raster', 'indexed_features',
        or 'vector_gis' for known input/output pin links and configuration.
        Results are gated by this server's loaded native catalog; unsupported
        workflows are not represented as runnable. Does not execute the graph.
name: get_geospatial_capabilities
title: Discover geospatial G1–G8 workflows
